name: grading-pending-open-shift
pathSql: SELECT '/api/packaging/terminal/grading/pending?shiftId=' || id FROM pkg_work_shifts WHERE status='OPEN' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

name: grading-pending-closed-shift-rejected
pathSql: SELECT '/api/packaging/terminal/grading/pending?shiftId=' || id FROM pkg_work_shifts WHERE status<>'OPEN' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
